title: 第8章  就这一回
slug: 四合院开局绑定空间农场
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“砰！”

一声闷响，李阳和秦淮茹齐齐摔在了炕上。

李阳压在她身上，两张脸都快贴一块儿了。

秦淮茹脸上烧得跟火炭似的。李阳没好气地瞪她：“你捅我痒痒肉干啥？我打小就怕这个！”

热气直往秦淮茹脸上扑，弄得她脑子有点懵。

她手忙脚乱地解释：“我、我真不是存心的，就想轻轻碰你一下试试，哪晓得你这么不禁闹。”

说完这话，两人都不吭声了，屋里头的气氛一下子变得黏糊糊的。

过了好半晌，李阳才压低了嗓子说：“姐，你真好看，馋死个人。”

秦淮茹见他眼眶里满满当当都是火，心里头慌得不行，赶紧说：

“李阳，你可不能动歪心思啊。你还没娶媳妇呢，往后能寻着比姐强百倍的姑娘。”

“姐都是俩孩子的娘了，咱可不能干那糊涂事。”

李阳低下头，把脸贴着她的脸，凑到她耳根子底下嘀咕：“姐，就一回，成不？”

“不成！我心里头过不去那道坎，咱不能犯浑。”秦淮茹脑袋往边上别了别，可躲不开。

两只手使劲推了推李阳，纹丝不动，心里更慌了。

李阳拿脸颊蹭着她的脸颊，又磨她：“你甭怕，就这一回，横竖也没人知道。你就当可怜可怜我今儿帮你跑前跑后的，让姐疼我一回，行不？”

“我这二十啷当岁的大小伙子，连男人女人那档子事都没闹明白过，姐你就遂了我的心思呗？”

秦淮茹稳了稳神，央告道：“李阳你静静心，不要乱来。”

“姐就是个乡下丫头，好不容易才在城里站住脚，你高抬贵手放过姐吧。”

“甭跟我提贾东旭那个混账！”李阳低声骂了一句，说：

“姐，你瞅他平日里是咋待你的？动不动就骂，一不顺心就打，他啥时候疼过你？”

“姐，你跟我在一块，我疼你。等回了城，咱还跟从前一样，我绝不给你添一丁点麻烦。”

说完，他便轻轻地在秦淮茹嘴唇上啄了一下。

秦淮茹心里头像打翻了五味瓶，又气又屈，又掺着一丝说不上来的动心。

这当口在李阳家里，她也不敢大声嚷嚷。就算李阳豁得出去，她还得顾全自己的脸面。

Page (1/3)

"Bang!"

With a muffled sound, Li Yang and Qin Huairu both fell on the kang.

Li Yang pressed on her, and their faces were almost touching.

Qin Huairu's face burned like coals.Li Yang glared at her angrily: "Why are you poking me? I've been afraid of this since I was a child!"

The hot air hit Qin Huairu's face, making her a little confused.

She hurriedly explained: "I, I really didn't mean to do it. I just wanted to touch you lightly and give it a try. I didn't know you could not help but make trouble."

After saying this, both of them fell silent, and the atmosphere in the room suddenly became sticky.

After a long while, Li Yang lowered his voice and said, "Sister, you are so beautiful, I'm so jealous."

Seeing that his eyes were filled with fire, Qin Huairu felt extremely panicked and quickly said:

"Li Yang, you can't let your mind wander. You haven't married yet. You can find a girl a hundred times better than my sister in the future."

"Sister, I am the mother of two children. We can't do such stupid things."

Li Yang lowered his head, put his face against hers, and whispered under her ear: "Sister, just for once, okay?"

"No! I can't get over that hurdle in my heart. We can't be stupid." Qin Huairu turned her head away, but she couldn't avoid it.

He pushed Li Yang hard with both hands, but he didn't move at all, and he felt even more panicked.

Li Yang rubbed his cheek against hers and rubbed her again: "Don't be afraid, just this time, no one will know anyway. Just think of me as pitiful and pitiful as I am running around for you today, and let my sister love me for once, okay?"

"I am a young man in my twenties, and I have never even understood the difference between men and women. Sister, are you going to follow my wishes?"

Qin Huairu calmed down and begged: "Li Yang, please calm down and don't act recklessly."

"I'm just a country girl. It's hard to get a foothold in the city. You're so noble and you should let me go."

"Don't mention that bastard Jia Dongxu to me!" Li Yang cursed in a low voice and said:

"Sister, how do you think he treats you on a daily basis? He scolds you at every turn, and hits you when you don't get your way. When has he ever hurt you?"

"Sister, if you are with me, I love you. When we return to the city, we will be the same as before. I will never cause you any trouble."

After saying that, he gently pecked Qin Huairu on the lips.

Qin Huairu's heart was filled with the image of knocking over the five-flavor bottle. She felt angry and aggrieved, mixed with a trace of unspeakable temptation.

This time at Li Yang's house, she didn't dare to yell loudly.Even if Li Yang is brave enough, she still has to take care of her own face.
